title: A Trip to the Cinema
description: Practise past simple and comparatives, and write about a trip to the cinema.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.text: 🎬 We ___ to the cinema on Saturday.

exercises.explanation: Add -s with it: the film starts.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: Subject + verb + object: Dad bought the tickets.

exercises.text: The film was ___ than the book.
exercises.explanation: Use "funnier than" to compare two things.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.

exercises.text: 🍿 We ___ be quiet in the cinema.

exercises.explanation: "Next to" means by the side of.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: Put "very" before the adjective: very funny.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.explanation: Yesterday is the past, so add -ed: laughed.

exercises.text: Tom ___ his coat at home yesterday.
It was the ___ film of the year. (good)

exercises.explanation: Use "does" with it in present simple questions.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: We had pizza after the film.
After the film we had pizza.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: The seats were more comfortable that my sofa.
answers: The seats were more comfortable than my sofa.

exercises.text: 🎟️ Linh and Mai ___ at the cinema at five. (be)
exercises.explanation: Use "were" with plural subjects in the past.

task.prompt: Write about a trip to the cinema. Say what happened.
task.modelAnswer: On Saturday I went to the cinema with my friend Ben. We saw a funny film about a dog. We ate popcorn and drank orange juice. The film was better than the last one. I liked it because I laughed a lot.
